description: Implement SIMShift's deterministic, truth-isolated synthetic domain, capability filter, event trace, profile policy transaction, virtual eUICC lifecycle, and dual recovery verification. This depends on FEAT-001 DTO/client conventions but remains fully testable offline.
steps: Create strict domain enums/models and exact BR_PROFILE/OFFLINE fixtures, then implement duplicate-safe repository loading, cross-field validation, opaque evaluator-truth handles, and positive observable projection.
Implement the stable ordered local action registry, deterministic capability filter, occurrence-indexed SHA-256 fleet effects, and independent registration/telemetry verifier.

Implement behavior/environment identity and strict atomic JSONL events with causal link and evaluator-leak validation; include separate decider, strands_framework_dispatch, strands_tool_host_model, explainer_model, telecom_simulator, and aws_deployment provenance.
Implement proposal-bound approval, all pure preview/final gates, incident-lock atomic commit, blocked audit, virtual transition states, exact-one-active-profile mutation, and duplicate suppression.
Add focused tests for schemas, fixtures, truth isolation, filtering, deterministic counts, trace links/provenance, approval binding, atomicity, virtual transition behavior, and dual checks.
acceptance_criteria: Both normative fixtures validate and evaluator truth cannot reach requests, tool DTOs, trace, logs, or explanation inputs.
OFFLINE filters retry, operator reselection, and profile evaluation; BR filters unavailable operator reselection.
An approved BR virtual transition succeeds only when separate registration and telemetry checks pass.
Every denied/mismatched/stale/consumed approval creates no command/transition and mutates no profile or approval state.
Trace provenance discloses a REAL Strands framework separately from the LOCAL_TEST_DOUBLE host model and explainer.

findings: Implemented the FEAT-002 offline domain slice: strict frozen closed-enum DTOs; exact BR_PROFILE/OFFLINE fixtures; duplicate-key, finite-number, UTF-8, size, external-reference, schema, and cross-field validation; opaque evaluator-truth handles and positive observable-only projection/leak rejection; stable six-action options and public-fact capability filtering; occurrence-indexed SHA-256 fleet effects and independent registration/telemetry recovery verification; deterministic behavior/environment identities; strict causal events with six separately disclosed provenance components and atomic fsync/rename JSONL recording; proposal-bound scripted approval, five pure gates, lock/recheck atomic commit, blocked audits, virtual eUICC lifecycle, one-active-profile switching, and duplicate suppression. Exact required verification evidence from the final tree: `uv run python -m simshift.cli validate-fixtures` exited 0 and printed `{"scenarios": ["BR_PROFILE", "OFFLINE"], "status": "VALID"}`; `uv run pytest -q tests/unit/test_domain_models.py tests/unit/test_scenario_repository.py tests/unit/test_projection_truth_isolation.py tests/unit/test_capability_filter.py tests/unit/test_simulator_effects.py tests/unit/test_seed_reproducibility.py tests/unit/test_recovery_verification.py` exited 0 with `16 passed in 0.06s`; `uv run pytest -q tests/unit/test_config_identity.py tests/unit/test_trace_events.py tests/unit/test_trace_links.py tests/unit/test_trace_atomic_write.py tests/unit/test_trace_provenance.py` exited 0 with `7 passed in 0.03s`; `uv run pytest -q tests/unit/test_profile_gates.py tests/unit/test_approval_binding.py tests/unit/test_transition_atomicity.py tests/unit/test_euicc_lifecycle.py tests/unit/test_duplicate_suppression.py` exited 0 with `8 passed in 0.05s`. Additional regression/quality evidence: `uv sync --frozen --extra dev` exited 0 (`Checked 59 packages`); final `uv run pytest -q` exited 0 with `72 passed in 0.21s`; standalone FEAT-001 router regression exited 0 with `40 passed in 0.13s`; `uv run ruff check .` exited 0 with `All checks passed!`; final `uv run mypy src patterns/capability_aware_router` exited 0 with `Success: no issues found in 38 source files`. Later-step handoff: FEAT-003 tool services should use `IncidentRuntime`, `filter_actions`, `VirtualFleetEngine.apply_action`, `prepare_profile_transition`, and positive `observable_projection`; profile proposal handling must first apply the evaluation observation update so runtime revision equals `prepared_observation_revision`, then trace the proposal before calling `materialize_approval`. FEAT-003/004 should route commits through `TransitionCoordinator`, dispatch approved records only through `VirtualEuiccEngine`, emit strict `TraceEvent` records through `TraceRecorder`, and use `RecoveryVerifier` as the only restored-status owner. The minimal CLI currently implements only FEAT-002's required `validate-fixtures`; run and policy-check remain assigned to later features. No Git, cloud, deployment, publication, offline-bundle hardening, article, or video action was performed.
